description: Set auto layout (flexbox) on frames, components or instances: direction, padding, gap, align, sizing (HUG/FILL via layoutSizing*). layoutPositioning, layoutAlign, layoutGrow set how a node sits in its parent. Results are per node.

counterAxisAlignItems.description: Cross axis align: MIN, CENTER, MAX, BASELINE

counterAxisSizingMode.description: Cross axis size: FIXED or AUTO (hug)

layoutAlign.description: This node's cross axis align in the parent's auto layout

layoutGrow.description: 1 = grow to fill the parent's main axis, 0 = keep size

layoutMode.description: Auto layout: HORIZONTAL, VERTICAL, or NONE

layoutPositioning.description: In the parent's auto layout: AUTO (in flow) or ABSOLUTE (free, at x/y)

layoutSizingHorizontal.description: Width mode: FIXED, HUG (fit content), or FILL (fill parent). Prefer over *AxisSizingMode. HUG needs auto layout on this node; FILL on its parent.

layoutSizingVertical.description: Height mode: FIXED, HUG, or FILL. Same rules as layoutSizingHorizontal.

primaryAxisAlignItems.description: Main axis align: MIN, CENTER, MAX, SPACE_BETWEEN

primaryAxisSizingMode.description: Main axis size: FIXED or AUTO (hug)

name: set_auto_layout
